A local-first wardrobe app that learns your sense of temperature,
aesthetic, and occasion — then suggests outfits from your own closet,
including combinations you'd never have thought of yourself. Three short
rating flows teach a personal model; an 11-table SQLite schema holds the
wardrobe; nothing leaves your machine.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **macOS** | [`ClosetMind-0.1.0.dmg`](https://github.com/chentzuyuan/ClosetMind_App/releases/download/v0.1.0/ClosetMind-0.1.0.dmg) | 95 MB | Apple Silicon / Intel; first launch: right-click → Open (Gatekeeper bypass) |
| **Windows** | [`ClosetMind-0.1.0-windows.zip`](https://github.com/chentzuyuan/ClosetMind_App/releases/download/v0.1.0/ClosetMind-0.1.0-windows.zip) | 210 MB | x64; unzip + run `ClosetMind.exe`; first launch: SmartScreen → More info → Run anyway |

Both builds ship a **Tester** sample wardrobe (54 items) so you can try
the recommendation flow on first launch without uploading any clothes
first. The setup screen also lets you start fresh with your own profile.

## Highlights

- **Three-stage XGBoost classifier chain** — temperature × aesthetic ×
  occasion, learned from three independent rating UIs so a single hard
  fail (wrong weather, wrong setting) zeros the score regardless of
  aesthetic.
- **Layer-coverage thermal model** — handles real cold-weather layering
  via cumulative-warmth curves, not just average insulation.
- **11-table SQLite schema** — profile-isolated wardrobes with
  idempotent ALTER TABLE migrations; switch profiles without restarting
  the app.
- **Drag-and-drop multi-item upload + batch CSV import** for getting
  your wardrobe in fast.
- **Optional .ics calendar import** for occasion auto-fill from your
  Google Calendar export.
- **Open-Meteo weather auto-fill** — call goes straight from your
  browser to the public API, never the server.
- **Local-first by design** — no cloud, no account, no telemetry; data
  lives in `~/MyClosetMind/` (or wherever you point it) and survives
  app reinstalls.

## Live demo

[**closetmind.onrender.com**](https://closetmind.onrender.com/) — full
FastAPI backend on Render's free tier, pre-seeded with the Tester
wardrobe. First visit ~50 s while the container wakes up; subsequent
loads are instant. Cold boots wipe `/tmp` and re-seed Tester, so the
demo always returns to a clean state.

See the [project landing page](https://chentzuyuan.github.io/closetmind.html)
for the broader pitch and embedded demo.
